newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Amcor arranges US$200 mln cp/mtn issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Amcor arranges US$200 mln cp/mtn issue.

text.p: Paper and packaging group Amcor Ltd said on Thursday it had arranged a US$200 million Euro-commercial paper and medium term note programme in Hong Kong, to be arranged by Commonwealth Bank of Australia.

Amcor said the new programme replaced an existing US$115 million commercial paper facility which matures next month and allowed the first issue of medium term notes into the Asian and European markets.
Dealers are Commonwealth Bank, BA Asia Ltd and BT Asia Ltd.
Amcor said the programme would provide valuable sources of short and medium term funding.
